people.name: Lazarus
people.line: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

translations.web: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
translations.bsb: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”
translations.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
translations.asv: These things spake he: and after this he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus is fallen asleep; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
